content:
rachel (support): :rotating_light: multiple customers reporting intermittent 503s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate since ~23:40 UTC. Customer examples and request-ids pasted below.

marta (eng-sre): grabbing it. can you paste the request-ids and a quick reproduction?

rachel (support): yes - sample: req=rc-3a7f2b, user=acme-inc, region=eu-west, client timeouts at ~10s. customer says retrying sometimes works.

karen (support): another: req=rc-7c9d01, client saw 502 then 503 on retry.

sanjay (eng-runtime): seeing increased queue depth on the batcher for hosted-gpu pool-2 around 23:38. p90 enqueue latency jumped. suspecting long-running upstream requests + KV cache misses.

ops-bot: autoscaler event: scaled pool-2 from 6 -> 9 instances at 23:45 UTC due to surge.

marta (eng-sre): good call. can we confirm auth-proxy latencies? sometimes auth timeouts propagate.

liam (platform): checking auth-proxy metrics now. auth proxy p95 spike to 1.8s, error rate +3% at same window. also saw a couple of 504s from internal auth | trace id t-9f2.

sanjay (eng-runtime): I pulled runtime traces: several model workers had KV cache warmup churn after a rollback we did earlier today. workers with cold KV cache show token-generation stalls -> upstream gateway times out.

rachel (support): customers want ETA and workaround. any quick mitigations?

marta (eng-sre): immediate mitigations: 1) enable short-circuit fallback routing to smaller model-variants for affected hosted endpoints, 2) temporarily increase pool-2 capacity, 3) tighten API gateway circuit breaker to fail fast for stuck workers.

liam (platform): executing scale + fallback now. running: `infra scale pool-2 --replicas 12` and `routing set-fallback --endpoint /v1/generate --variant small-quant`

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: routing fallback update started (id df-452).

ops-bot: scale action queued, expected healthy nodes in ~2m.

sanjay (eng-runtime): also recommend reducing max-batch-size for pool-2 to reduce per-request tail latency. command: `runtime update pool-2 --max-batch-size 8`

marta (eng-sre): applying `max-batch-size=8` now. note: this will increase throughput cost but reduces latency.

liam (platform): applied. pool-2 nodes returning to steady p95 after warmup.

sanjay (eng-runtime): confirmed: KV cache hit-rate increasing after warmup; many older cold workers evicted earlier during rollback, causing regen load.

rachel (support): can we offer customers a targeted retry guidance? they asked about exponential backoff vs immediate retries.

alex (product): advise clients to use jittered exponential backoff with max retries 3 and to fall back to smaller model variant if supported. we should also offer proactive credit for errors for impacted customers — marta can you quantify impact?

marta (eng-sre): drafting impact: rough calc from logs: ~3200 requests failed across 9 tenants during 23:38-23:52 UTC. I'll post a more precise number in 30m.

karen (support): I'll prepare an interim customer message: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx responses during a late-night surge. We've applied mitigations (scale, routing fallback) and will follow up with root cause and timeline." shareable?

alex (product): good. add note re possible retries & credit offer pending more details.

marta (eng-sre): initial root-cause hypothesis: regression from earlier rollback + cold KV cache + auth-proxy latency amplification -> backlog on batcher -> gateway 502/503 cascade. needs postmortem validation.

sanjay (eng-runtime): action items for short-term: `A1` increase KV cache warmup throttling, `A2` add health-check for cold worker token stalls, `A3` temporary tighter circuit-breaker thresholds.

liam (platform): action items for platform: `P1` revisit rollback playbook to avoid mass worker restarts during high load, `P2` make fallback routing auto-enable when pool enqueue latency > threshold.

marta (eng-sre): ops action: `S1` collect traces for all failed req ids (rachel/karen will attach customer ids). `S2` synth load test to reproduce warmup pattern.

rachel (support): attaching logs in thread: 
```
[23:41:12] rc-3a7f2b -> gateway 503 upstream timeout worker=w-23 pool=pool-2
[23:41:12] auth-proxy t-9f2 auth err: context deadline exceeded (1.9s)
[23:41:13] worker w-23 trace: kv-cache miss, fetch model shard, stall 2.1s
```

marta (eng-sre): thanks. please also upload any customer traces to S3 path `s3://redwood-incidents/1799999000/`

karen (support): uploaded two customer logs and reproduction curl commands.

sanjay (eng-runtime): created a short-live canary to verify fallback path correctness. all good.

marta (eng-sre): summary for postmortem: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, mitigations applied, customer impact numbers, action owners. I'll own the postmortem doc and set a follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

alex (product): assign comms owner to finalize customer note once marta posts impact numbers — karen you can prepare final draft after we have numbers.

rachel (support): +1. I'll queue customer comms and share in #support-updates.

liam (platform): follow-ups I own: P1, P2 (ETA 3 days), and I'll add an automation ticket to flip fallback on when enqueue p95 > 300ms.

sanjay (eng-runtime): I own A1, A2 (ETA 48 hours) — will add unit tests for worker warmup.

marta (eng-sre): S1/S2 assigned to me and ops team. postmortem doc link (draft): https://docs.redwood.ai/pm/incident-1799999000-draft (will update).

deploy-bot: routing fallback df-452 completed at 23:48 UTC.

ops-bot: pool-2 scaled to 12 healthy nodes at 23:47 UTC.

marta (eng-sre): closing this realtime thread. final postmortem to include: 1) why rollback caused mass KV eviction, 2) why auth latencies amplified the queue, 3) why circuit breaker thresholds didn't trip early, 4) customer impact & credits.

rachel (support): thanks all. I'll CC customers once we have the postmortem and credit proposal. :thumbsup:

alex (product): great work. we'll track action items in the incident board.

marta (eng-sre): last note: please attach any additional traces to the doc. I'll update owners/timelines by EOD.
